name: Lunaris Filia ~Kiss to Keiyaku to Shinku no Hitomi~
original_name: Lunaris Filia～キスと契約と深紅の瞳～
source:
Two important childhood memories: one that mustn’t be forgotten, and one he’ll never forget. These are the memories of Sousuke’s childhood encounters with two important women in his life: the now-forgotten vampire princess Silvia, and his always-close-by childhood friend Yukari.  

Now, many years later, Silvia returns as promised to fulfill her blood pact with Sousuke, but things didn’t go as planned.  Not only does Sousuke not remember her, but his blood has been “tainted” by another vampire without him knowing it.  To a vampire, the relationship with their contracted partner is a lot like a “first love”, and it’s totally forbidden and taboo for another vampire to “steal” someone under another vampire’s pact.  Unfortunately, the vampire responsible — someone very close to Sousuke — doesn’t appear to be aware of what she did.  

Before Sylvia can forcibly undo the improper blood pact to restore her own, Sousuke’s father proposes a special arrangement: since the blood pact depends on the mutual feelings of the contractor and contracted, within the next lunar month whoever Sousuke comes to love most will keep their contract. Not happy with the way things are going, Sousuke’s (adopted) younger sister Mai declares suddenly that she’s entering the “game” as well in order to protect her beloved older brother from these vampires.  Sousuke’s peaceful days are over…

[From [url=http://www.relentlessness.com/blog/2011/08/augustseptember-2011-random-eroge-trial-impressions/]Relentlessflame[/url]]
translation:
主角拥有两段重要的童年记忆：一段本不该忘记，却已被他遗忘；另一段则永远不会忘。它们分别来自他生命中的两名重要女性——如今已被遗忘的吸血鬼公主西尔维娅，以及总陪在身旁的青梅竹马水无濑紫。

多年后，西尔维娅如约归来，准备履行与主角的血之契约，事情却并未按计划发展。主角不仅完全不记得她，自己的血还在不知情时遭另一名吸血鬼“玷污”。对吸血鬼而言，与契约对象的关系近似“初恋”；其他吸血鬼夺走已有契约之人，是绝对禁止的禁忌。偏偏造成这一切的吸血鬼就在主角身边，而且似乎根本没意识到自己做了什么。

西尔维娅正要强行解除错误的血契、恢复原有契约，主角的父亲却提出一项特别安排：血契取决于缔约双方的感情，因此在接下来的一个月内，最终最受主角爱慕的人将保留契约。眼见局势不妙，主角的养妹速水真衣也突然宣布加入这场“游戏”，要保护心爱的哥哥不受吸血鬼侵害。主角平静的日子就此结束……
